# Vinha dos Padres

> Vinha dos Padres is an altitude amphora (talha) wine estate in Reguengo, Portalegre, in the Serra de São Mamede Natural Park, Alto Alentejo, Portugal (DOC Alentejo Portalegre, est. 1795). Six vineyard properties of centenary bush vines are made into wine in centenary clay amphoras (talhas). Its first vintage, Quinta da Vinha dos Padres 2022 red 3M12M, was ranked #32 with 94 points in James Suckling's Top 100 Wines of Portugal 2025 — no amphora (talha) wine in Portugal scored or ranked higher.

The site is in English; a Portuguese version is coming soon.

## Estate

- [Estate & terroir](https://www.vinhadospadres.com/): the six vineyard properties on an interactive map, with 3D parcels, harvest and climate data, and a terroir layer showing the geology of the Serra de São Mamede and the Portalegre DOC in 2D and 3D
- [History](https://www.vinhadospadres.com/history): from the Jesuits' first vow in Paris in 1534 to the vineyard in Reguengo today
- [Amphora (talha) wine](https://www.vinhadospadres.com/amphora-wine): what amphora (talha) wine is, how Vinha dos Padres makes it in historic Campo Maior talhas (destemmed, sealed by flor, covered with cloth, no olive oil), and why it works outside the Vinho de Talha DOC rules
- [The code](https://www.vinhadospadres.com/code): how to read the code on every label — months of skin maceration and total ageing in amphora (M = months), plus any ageing in another vessel
